question:
**Select the option with the correct spellings to replace the underlined words in the given sentence.**

He __exhibitad__ his __senseles__ behaviour at that conference.
solution:
The correct answer is: **exhibited; senseless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Exhibited **is the correct spelling of the word that means to show or display something. (कुछ दिखाना या प्रदर्शित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The artist exhibited a stunning collection of abstract paintings at the gallery.*
 
 
 
• **Senseless **is the correct spelling of the word that means lacking in sense or understanding. (समझ का अभाव)
 
 
• **Example**: *The act of vandalism was senseless, causing damage to public property without any apparent reason.*
 
 
 
• It is important to use correct spelling in written communication to ensure clear and effective communication.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
